sales_notes: Homeowner preferred the high-efficiency system, but the monthly payment was more than the household could manage. They asked whether another payment structure could be reviewed.
transcript: Customer: "The system is the one we want, but the monthly payment is the blocker. If there is another payment option, we are still interested."

sales_notes: Studio manager liked the quiet mini-split proposal and asked us to reconnect after the fall event schedule clears.
transcript: Customer: "Please check back in about four weeks. We want to do this, just not while the studio is booked every day."

sales_notes: Facilities manager supports the replacement, but the ownership group must approve the capital request at its next meeting.
transcript: Facilities manager: "Keep the proposal open. I am recommending it, but the owners have the final approval."

sales_notes: Estimate was sent after the home visit. The salesperson went on leave and the promised follow-up was never completed, although the homeowner had asked about installation timing.
transcript: Customer: "The estimate looks reasonable. Call me tomorrow with the installation window and we can decide."

sales_notes: Bakery compared three bids and said our total price was higher than the preferred alternative. The owner asked whether the scope could be simplified without removing essential ventilation work.
transcript: Owner: "Your proposal is clear, but the total is above what we planned. Show me a leaner option and I will review it."

sales_notes: Office manager confirmed that another provider completed the replacement last week. The new system is operating and no further quote review is needed.
transcript: Customer: "The other contractor has already finished the installation, so please close this estimate."

sales_notes: Homeowner requested both standard and high-efficiency options, opened the estimate, and then stopped replying. Three spaced follow-ups received no response.
transcript: Customer: "Send both furnace options. I want to compare the operating costs before choosing." No later customer response is recorded.

sales_notes: Cafe owner liked the replacement plan, but the financing application did not move forward. They asked whether they could revisit the purchase after improving cash reserves.
transcript: Owner: "I still need the unit, but I cannot take on the payment right now. Let us revisit financing later."

sales_notes: The center paused the project until its next grant cycle. Staff still want the quieter heat-pump solution before the winter program begins.
transcript: Director: "The proposal fits our needs. We have to wait for the next funding decision before committing."

sales_notes: Resident completed the estimate visit, but two co-owners who share the property had not approved the replacement.
transcript: Customer: "I am comfortable with the furnace. My co-owners need to agree before anyone signs."

sales_notes: Clinic liked the air-quality benefits, but the full package exceeded the approved budget. The manager asked for a smaller first phase.
transcript: Manager: "The air filtration makes sense, but the complete package costs more than we can approve this quarter."

sales_notes: Clinic is leaning toward its long-standing maintenance vendor, although the replacement decision was not final when the opportunity closed.
transcript: Administrator: "Your design is competitive, but our existing vendor already knows the building and the board prefers them."

sales_notes: Customer asked for a written repair estimate, then did not reply to two calls and one email. No preference or objection was captured.
Committee requested references and clearer warranty documentation after receiving inconsistent answers during two calls. They did not feel confident proceeding.
transcript: Committee member: "We received different answers about the work, so we are not comfortable approving this proposal."

sales_notes: Gallery needed a concealed, near-silent solution. The proposed wall-mounted system did not meet the visual and noise requirements for the exhibition room.
transcript: Curator: "The equipment works, but a visible wall unit does not fit this space."

sales_notes: Bookshop needed heat restored within two days. The earliest service opening was the following week, so the manager sought immediate help elsewhere.
transcript: Manager: "We cannot keep the shop cold for a week. We need a technician sooner."

sales_notes: Two estimate appointments were missed and the homeowner received conflicting scope details. The customer asked not to receive another sales call.
transcript: Customer: "After two missed appointments, I have lost confidence in the process. Please close the quote."

sales_notes: Inquiry came from a short-term tenant without landlord authorization or an approved capital budget. The request was exploratory rather than a purchasable project.
transcript: Tenant: "I cannot authorize building work; I only wanted an estimate to show the property owner."
Customer: "We want to proceed, but please confirm the warranty details first." Salesperson: "I will call tomorrow with the answer." No later contact is recorded.
